purpose: Provide the one deterministic, read-only first invocation for a fresh AgentOS Bootstrap agent.

invocation.path_rule: AGENTOS_ROOT and PROJECT_ROOT are exact absolute paths. PROJECT_ROOT is canonicalized and must be a real directory. An explicit control-plane mode requires an exact absolute CONTROL_PLANE_ROOT; read-only start validates but never creates it.

result.binding: start_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the complete result with start_sha256 omitted; discovery and question_plan retain their own exact digests; control_plane binds either the validated explicit selection or the default external storage decision without creating that folder.

safety.next_step: Continue through the canonical Bootstrap controller after material questions. The default JSA mode may continue only declared in-scope setup; protected actions retain their own exact authority boundary and changed scope returns to reassessment.

extension_boundary: Project-specific context may affect discovery facts and later typed answers, but cannot replace this invocation, weaken its read-only behavior, or alter the canonical controller.
